items.title: 勃兰登堡协奏曲
items.creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
items.note: 六首大协奏曲风格各异，几乎穷尽了巴洛克协奏曲的形态可能，是管弦乐配器的教科书。
items.noteEn: Six concerti grossi of wildly varied scoring — a masterclass in Baroque orchestration.

items.title: 平均律钢琴曲集（第一卷）
items.creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
items.note: 二十四对前奏曲与赋格遍历全部大小调，确立了调性体系与复调钢琴的圣经。
items.noteEn: Twenty-four preludes and fugues in every key — the Old Testament of tonal counterpoint.

items.title: 四季
items.creator: Antonio Vivaldi
items.note: 四首小提琴协奏曲配十四行诗，鸟鸣、冰面与风暴被音符写实到几乎可以看见。
items.noteEn: Four violin concertos with sonnets — birdsong, ice and storms painted in literal tone.

items.title: 哥德堡变奏曲
items.creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
items.note: 一首咏叹调引出三十段变奏，单主题穷尽键盘技法与对位的宇宙。
items.noteEn: One aria spinning into thirty variations — a universe of counterpoint and keyboard technique.

items.title: 弥赛亚
items.creator: George Frideric Handel
items.note: 从诞生到复活的全本清唱剧，《哈利路亚》合唱让英王起立的传说流传至今。
items.noteEn: An oratorio from Nativity to Resurrection — the Hallelujah Chorus that made kings rise.

items.title: 第45交响曲「告别」
items.creator: Joseph Haydn
items.note: 末乐章乐手逐一吹灭蜡烛离席，向雇主暗示该给乐手们放假了。
items.noteEn: Players snuff out candles and leave one by one — a hint that the court should grant a holiday.

items.title: G大调弦乐小夜曲
items.creator: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
items.note: 四乐章如被压缩到极限的古典主义样本，小夜曲成了莫扎特最出圈的旋律之一。
items.noteEn: Four movements of concentrated Classicism — the serenade that made Mozart ubiquitous.

items.title: D小调安魂曲
items.creator: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
items.note: 未竟之作由学生续完，安魂弥撒成了莫扎特死亡的预写。
items.noteEn: Left unfinished, completed by a pupil — the Requiem as a prophecy of Mozart's own death.

items.title: 第14钢琴奏鸣曲「月光」
items.creator: Ludwig van Beethoven
items.note: 三连音琶音的第一乐章如夜曲，慢-中-快的不寻常结构预演了浪漫主义。
items.noteEn: The triplet arpeggios of the first movement read like a nocturne — an unusual slow-mid-fast shape.

items.title: C小调第五交响曲
items.creator: Ludwig van Beethoven
items.note: 三短一长的「命运动机」从第一小节统治到末乐章，是交响曲中最强的叙事弧。
items.noteEn: The four-note fate motif governs the whole symphony — Western music's most famous arc.

items.title: 第八交响曲「未完成」
items.creator: Franz Schubert
items.note: 只写完两个乐章却已自足，第一乐章的歌唱性主部是浪漫主义交响的曙光。
items.noteEn: Only two movements, yet complete in itself — its lyric first movement dawns the Romantic symphony.

items.title: D小调第九交响曲「合唱」
items.creator: Ludwig van Beethoven
items.note: 首次把席勒《欢乐颂》唱进交响曲，人声与乐队在末乐章合流为乌托邦式的高潮。
items.noteEn: Schiller's Ode to Joy sung by chorus and orchestra — a utopian finale that changed the form.

items.title: 冬之旅
items.creator: Franz Schubert
items.note: 二十四首歌串起一个失恋者走向雪夜的旅程，艺术歌曲的心理深度由此确立。
items.noteEn: Twenty-four songs tracing a jilted wanderer's walk into the snow — the emotional summit of the Lied.

items.title: G小调第一叙事曲
items.creator: Frédéric Chopin
items.note: 叙事曲体裁的奠基之作，复杂的和声与即兴般的展开让钢琴成为说故事的乐器。
items.noteEn: The genre's founding work — narrative drama smuggled into pianistic texture.

items.title: 童年情景
items.creator: Robert Schumann
items.note: 十三首钢琴小品回望童年，《梦幻曲》用简单到极致的和声制造无限温柔。
items.noteEn: Thirteen piano miniatures looking back at childhood; Traumerei's simple harmony is pure tenderness.

items.title: E小调小提琴协奏曲
items.creator: Felix Mendelssohn
items.note: 独奏开头即直入主题、三乐章无间断衔接，甜美与炫技并存的协奏曲典范。
items.noteEn: The soloist enters with the theme at once and movements run on — sweetness and virtuosity fused.

items.title: 匈牙利狂想曲第二号
items.creator: Franz Liszt
items.note: 慢板引子到弗里斯舞曲，吉普赛音阶与炫技跑动让这首作品成了动画配乐常客。
items.noteEn: Lassan to friska, Gypsy scales and bravura runs — a cartoon-score staple.

items.title: 茶花女
items.creator: Giuseppe Verdi
items.note: 让交际花当女主角的写实歌剧，《饮酒歌》的轻快与第三幕的哀歌同样锋利。
items.noteEn: A courtesan heroine breaks operatic convention — brindisi sparkle and final-act elegy cut equally.

items.title: 特里斯坦与伊索尔德
items.creator: Richard Wagner
items.note: 前奏曲的和声迟迟不肯解决，被称「特里斯坦和弦」，直接松开调性的地基。
items.noteEn: The unresolved 'Tristan chord' loosens tonality's foundations — an erotic, endless prelude.

items.title: 安魂弥撒
items.creator: Giuseppe Verdi
items.note: 把歌剧的戏剧张力带进弥撒，《Dies irae》的铜管与合唱是末日的音响。
items.noteEn: Operatic drama inside the liturgy — the Dies irae's brass and chorus sound like Judgment Day.

items.title: 降B小调第一钢琴协奏曲
items.en: Piano Concerto No. 1 in B-flat minor (Tchaikovsky)
items.creator: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
items.note: 开篇圆号奏出辉煌主题，被作曲家称为「洪水般的浪漫主义」，是比赛舞台常客。
items.noteEn: The horn's opening fanfare floods with romance — a competition-stage warhorse.

items.title: 天鹅湖
items.creator: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
items.note: 双簧管奏出的天鹅主题与黑天鹅的变奏，让芭蕾音乐第一次获得交响的深度。
items.noteEn: The oboe's swan theme and Odile's variations give ballet music symphonic weight.

items.title: C小调第一交响曲
items.creator: Johannes Brahms
items.note: 被汉斯利克称「贝多芬第十」，终乐章主题与贝九呼应，是二十年磨一剑的答卷。
items.noteEn: Dubbed 'Beethoven's Tenth' — the finale nods to the Ninth in a two-decade-long answer.

items.title: 吉诺佩蒂
items.creator: Erik Satie
items.note: 三首裸体舞曲的疏离和声为「背景音乐」开了先河，被视为氛围音乐的精神始祖。
items.noteEn: Three detached piano dances that prefigure background music — ambient's spiritual ancestor.

items.title: 天方夜谭
items.creator: Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov
items.note: 独奏小提琴代表王妃舍赫拉查德，用音画配器把一千零一夜讲成管弦乐。
items.noteEn: A solo violin voices Scheherazade herself — a thousand and one nights as orchestral color.

items.title: 第六交响曲「悲怆」
items.creator: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
items.note: 末乐章一反常规以慢板收束并渐弱至无声，九天之后作曲家离世。
items.noteEn: The finale breaks convention — a slow fade to nothing, days before the composer's death.

items.title: 第九交响曲「自新大陆」
items.en: Symphony No. 9 in E minor 'From the New World' (Dvorak)
items.creator: Antonín Dvořák
items.note: 在美国写就的思乡之作，第二乐章英国管旋律被改编成《念故乡》。
items.noteEn: A homesick symphony written in America — the Largo's cor anglais melody became Goin' Home.

items.title: 第五交响曲
items.creator: Gustav Mahler
items.note: 从葬礼进行曲到终乐章回旋曲，著名的柔板曾被电影《魂断威尼斯》借用。
items.noteEn: Funeral march to rondo; the Adagietto became a film score for Death in Venice.

items.title: 月光
items.creator: Claude Debussy
items.note: 《贝加马斯克组曲》第三段，全音阶与踏板制造出水面浮光的印象派月色。
items.noteEn: The third movement of Suite bergamasque — whole tones and pedal paint Impressionist moonlight.

items.title: 大地之歌
items.creator: Gustav Mahler
items.note: 以唐诗德译入歌的交响声乐套曲，末乐章《告别》绵延近半小时。
items.noteEn: Tang poems in German sung over orchestra — the half-hour Farewell closes on solitude.

items.title: 春之祭
items.creator: Igor Stravinsky
items.note: 首演引发骚乱，不协和音与重音错位的原始主义把音乐史拦腰截断。
items.noteEn: Its premiere caused a riot — dissonance and displaced accents split music history in two.

items.title: 蓝色狂想曲
items.creator: George Gershwin
items.note: 爵士与古典的混血，开篇单簧管滑音成了二十世纪最著名的起手式之一。
items.noteEn: Jazz meets the concert hall — the opening clarinet glissando is a century-defining lick.

items.title: 波莱罗
items.creator: Maurice Ravel
items.note: 同一旋律在固定节奏上反复十八遍、只靠配器渐强，是一场渐变而非变奏的赌注。
items.noteEn: One tune repeated eighteen times over a fixed rhythm — crescendo by orchestration alone.

items.title: 西区布鲁斯
items.creator: Louis Armstrong
items.note: 开场六小节小号华彩与结尾即兴，把爵士从合奏时代带到独奏天才的时代。
items.noteEn: Six opening bars of trumpet cadenza reset jazz — the soloist era begins.

items.title: 第五交响曲
items.creator: Dmitri Shostakovich
items.note: 在遭受批判后以「一个苏联艺术家对公正批评的答复」自述，末乐章在掌声与疑虑之间摇摆。
items.noteEn: A 'Soviet artist's reply to just criticism' — a finale torn between triumph and irony.

items.title: 奇异果实
items.creator: Billie Holiday
items.note: 把私刑受害者的尸体唱成「南方树上的奇异果实」，爵士最痛的反抗之声。
items.noteEn: Lynched bodies as 'strange fruit' on Southern trees — jazz's most searing protest.

items.title: 黄河大合唱
items.creator: 冼星海
items.note: 八乐章合唱套曲写于延安窑洞，《黄河颂》与《保卫黄河》成为民族抗战的号角。
items.noteEn: An eight-movement cantata written in a Yan'an cave — a rallying cry of national resistance.

items.title: 沙尘暴民谣
items.creator: Woody Guthrie
items.note: 《This Land Is Your Land》的作者把大萧条写进美国歌本。
items.noteEn: The work of 'This Land Is Your Land''s author, setting the Depression to song.

items.title: 黑、棕与米色
items.creator: Duke Ellington
items.note: 三乐章的爵士长作首演于卡内基音乐厅，想「把美国黑人的历史写进音乐」。
items.noteEn: A three-movement jazz epic premiered at Carnegie Hall, telling African-American history in sound.

items.title: 阿巴拉契亚之春
items.creator: Aaron Copland
items.note: 为芭蕾而作，香客主题的变奏透出开阔的美国大地气质，是柯普兰「美式之声」的代表。
items.noteEn: Ballet score whose Shaker-tune variations breathe the American prairie — Copland's open sound.

items.title: 每天都发生怪事
items.creator: Sister Rosetta Tharpe
items.note: 把福音与布吉乌吉钢琴合成一体，常被视为摇滚乐的最早萌芽之一。
items.noteEn: Gospel swing with boogie piano — often cited as a seed of rock and roll.

items.title: Ko-Ko
items.creator: Charlie Parker
items.note: 以不协和的前奏和极速的即兴奠定比波普语法，帕克在此彻底告别摇摆乐。
items.noteEn: Dissonant head and breakneck lines lock in bebop — swing is left behind for good.

items.title: 暴风雨般的星期一
items.en: Call It Stormy Monday (But Tuesday Is Just as Bad)
items.creator: T-Bone Walker
items.note: 电吉他在蓝调中的奠基之作，推弦与爵士式独奏影响了整整一代吉他手。
items.noteEn: Electric guitar blues at its root — bends and jazz lines that shaped a generation of pickers.

items.title: 猪油
items.creator: Dizzy Gillespie
items.note: 与古巴康加鼓手查诺·波索共创，非洲古巴节奏正式进入爵士。
items.noteEn: Co-written with Cuban conguero Chano Pozo — Afro-Cuban rhythm enters jazz for good.

items.title: 二泉映月
items.en: Erquan Yingyue (Moon Reflected on Second Spring)
items.creator: 华彦钧（阿炳）
items.note: 盲人艺术家阿炳的二胡曲，1950年抢救式录音后成为民族器乐的巅峰之作。
items.noteEn: Blind musician Abing's erhu piece, preserved in a 1950 field recording — the apex of Chinese solo strings.

items.title: 扫掉灰尘
items.creator: Elmore James
items.note: 把罗伯特·约翰逊的《I Believe I'll Dust My Broom》电声化，滑棒吉他的「啸叫」在此定格。
items.noteEn: Electrifying Robert Johnson's song — the slide-guitar wail that became Elmore James' signature.

items.title: 哥德堡变奏曲（古尔德1955年录音）
items.creator: Glenn Gould
items.note: 22岁的古尔德用断奏与飞奔速度重定义巴赫，录音室成为演奏家的新舞台。
items.noteEn: A 22-year-old rethinks Bach in clipped, breakneck style — the studio as concert stage.

items.title: 纽波特现场
items.creator: Duke Ellington
items.note: 《渐弱与渐强之蓝》中长达六分多钟的萨克斯即兴让现场沸腾，爵士乐迎来复兴拐点。
items.noteEn: A six-minute saxophone solo on Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue ignites a career revival.

items.title: 萨克斯巨像
items.creator: Sonny Rollins
items.note: 《St. Thomas》的加勒比节奏与《You Don't Know What Love Is》的慢板，罗林斯的轮转即兴巅峰。
items.noteEn: Caribbean St. Thomas and a searching ballad — Rollins at his thematic-improv peak.

items.title: 三首拉格
items.creator: Ravi Shankar
items.note: 西塔琴大师为西方录制的经典，印度古典乐的世界信使。
items.noteEn: The sitar master's classic Western release — India's classical ambassador to the world.

items.title: 酷派的诞生
items.creator: Miles Davis
items.note: 九重奏的非典型编制与弱化颤音的吹奏，为冷爵士定下「以退为进」的美学。
items.noteEn: A nonet's mellow textures and vibrato-free playing define cool jazz as understatement.

items.title: 璀璨角落
items.creator: Thelonious Monk
items.note: 标题曲的节奏角度刁钻到乐队录了25遍，蒙克的棱角在混乱中自成秩序。
items.noteEn: The title track's crooked angles took 25 takes — Monk's jagged logic orders the chaos.

items.title: 蓝色列车
items.creator: John Coltrane
items.note: 硬波普的标准范本，同名曲的蓝调节奏与首句号角般的旋律辨识度极高。
items.noteEn: A hard-bop textbook — the title tune's blues line and fanfare head are instantly recognizable.

items.title: 忧郁小女孩
items.creator: Nina Simone
items.note: 首张专辑里的《My Baby Just Cares for Me》几十年后被香水广告重新带红。
items.noteEn: Debut LP whose My Baby Just Cares for Me returned to fame decades later via an ad.

items.title: 呻吟
items.creator: Art Blakey & The Jazz Messengers
items.note: 鲍比·蒂蒙斯的灵魂蓝调主题让硬波普有了「教堂感」，鼓手的轰鸣定义Messengers之声。
items.noteEn: Bobby Timmons' gospel-tinged theme sanctifies hard bop — Blakey's drive defines the sound.

items.title: 别的什么
items.creator: Cannonball Adderley
items.note: 米尔斯·戴维斯以小号嘉宾身份助阵，《Autumn Leaves》与同名曲的慢板堪称教科书。
items.noteEn: Miles Davis guests on trumpet — Autumn Leaves and the title cut are studies in taste.

items.title: 梁祝小提琴协奏曲
items.creator: 何占豪 & 陈钢
items.note: 越剧音调入交响，小提琴与大提琴的「楼台会」把东方爱情悲剧写成单乐章协奏曲。
items.noteEn: Shaoxing opera inside a one-movement concerto — an Eastern love tragedy told by two instruments.

items.title: 蓝色情调
items.creator: Miles Davis
items.note: 全调式即兴的杰作，《So What》的两音动机让爵士摆脱和弦变化的束缚。
items.noteEn: Modal jazz's defining statement — the two-note So What riff frees soloists from chord changes.

items.title: 明格斯，嗯
items.creator: Charles Mingus
items.note: 《Goodbye Pork Pie Hat》悼念莱斯特·扬，整张专辑是民权时代美国的声音侧写。
items.noteEn: Goodbye Pork Pie Hat mourns Lester Young — the album is a sonic profile of civil-rights America.

items.title: 月光下呻吟
items.creator: Howlin' Wolf
items.note: 首张专辑收录《Smokestack Lightnin'》，沃夫沙哑的嚎叫定义了芝加哥蓝调的另一极。
items.noteEn: Debuting Smokestack Lightnin' — Howlin' Wolf's guttural howl defines the other pole of Chicago blues.

items.title: 爵士乐未来的形状
items.en: The Shape of Jazz to Come
items.creator: Ornette Coleman
items.note: 无既定和声伴奏的自由即兴（Harmolodics），让爵士进入没有和弦图的开放空间。
items.noteEn: Free improvisation without preset changes — harmonolodics opens jazz to boundless space.

items.title: 暂停时间
items.creator: The Dave Brubeck Quartet
items.note: 《Take Five》的5/4拍成为爵士最出圈的节奏实验，封面几何画亦是经典。
items.noteEn: Take Five's 5/4 meter is jazz's most famous rhythmic gamble, wrapped in geometric art.

items.title: 艾拉在柏林
items.en: Ella in Berlin: Mack the Knife
items.creator: Ella Fitzgerald
items.note: 忘词后用即兴拟声唱完《Mack the Knife》，现场史上最著名的「救场」。
items.noteEn: Forgetting the lyrics, she scats her way through Mack the Knife — live jazz's greatest save.

items.title: 大步流星
items.creator: John Coltrane
items.note: 同名曲的和声每两个小节就转调，被乐手当作即兴的「毕业考试」。
items.noteEn: The title tune changes key every two bars — the endurance test of jazz improvisation.

items.title: 第八弦乐四重奏
items.creator: Dmitri Shostakovich
items.note: 题献「纪念法西斯主义的受难者」，却在其中嵌入作曲家自己的签名动机DSCH。
items.noteEn: Dedicated to victims of fascism yet built on his own DSCH motto — a coded self-portrait.

items.title: 自由爵士：集体即兴
items.creator: Ornette Coleman
items.note: 双四重奏分置左右声道，近40分钟不间断的集体即兴，为整个流派命名。
items.noteEn: Two quartets in separate stereo channels improvise for 40 minutes — the genre gets its name.

items.title: 村庄先锋周日现场
items.creator: Bill Evans Trio
items.note: 爵士钢琴三重奏的圣杯，贝斯手斯科特·拉法罗离世前四天的现场录音。
items.noteEn: The holy grail of piano trios — recorded four days before bassist Scott LaFaro died.

items.title: 乡村与西部音乐的新声音
items.en: Modern Sounds in Country and Western Music
items.creator: Ray Charles
items.note: 把乡村金曲改造成灵魂乐编曲，跨类型的胆识震惊了整个行业。
items.noteEn: Country standards reimagined as soul arrangements — a genre-bending move that stunned the industry.

items.title: 阿波罗现场
items.creator: James Brown
items.note: 一张现场专辑让灵魂乐第一次拥有「史诗现场」的概念，能量几乎掀翻屋顶。
items.noteEn: A live album that invented the idea of the epic soul concert — energy threatening to lift the roof.

items.title: 黑圣人与罪妇
items.en: The Black Saint and the Sinner Lady
items.creator: Charles Mingus
items.note: 六乐章的大编制芭蕾式组曲，班卓琴与低音号让明格斯的野心近乎管弦乐。
items.noteEn: A six-movement ballet for a large ensemble — banjo and tuba push Mingus near orchestral scale.

items.title: 你是我的一生
items.creator: Oum Kalthoum
items.note: 阿拉伯世界的月亮，一首歌长达四十分钟的即兴史诗。
items.noteEn: The 'Star of the East' — a 40-minute improvisatory epic that still hypnotizes the Arab world.

items.title: 盖茨与吉尔伯托
items.creator: Stan Getz & João Gilberto
items.note: 《The Girl from Ipanema》让巴萨诺瓦席卷全球，1965年获格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: The Girl from Ipanema took bossa nova worldwide — the 1965 Album of the Year.

items.title: 出去吃午饭
items.creator: Eric Dolphy
items.note: 低音单簧管与铁琴的奇异音色对话，前卫爵士中最具音色想象力的奇作。
items.noteEn: Bass clarinet and vibes in skewed dialogue — avant-garde jazz's most colorful mind.

items.title: 至高无上的爱
items.creator: John Coltrane
items.note: 四乐章组曲是科川写给上帝的感恩献词，「Acknowledgement」里的四音动机贯穿全篇。
items.noteEn: A four-part suite of gratitude to God — the four-note motto of Acknowledgement binds it.

items.title: 重返61号公路
items.creator: Bob Dylan
items.note: 《Like a Rolling Stone》开创民谣摇滚纪元，电吉他对民谣的背叛与新生。
items.noteEn: 'Like a Rolling Stone' announced the folk-rock era — electric betrayal and rebirth of folk.

items.title: 闲暇时刻
items.creator: Grant Green
items.note: 同名曲的十二分钟慢板慵懒到极致，是灵魂爵士里被低估的宝藏。
items.noteEn: The twelve-minute title ballad lounges to perfection — soul jazz's hidden gem.

items.title: 皇宫剧院现场
items.creator: B.B. King
items.note: 单音式颤音吉他对着芝加哥观众全力释放，被公认为最佳现场蓝调录音之一；金2004年获极地音乐奖。
items.noteEn: Vibrato guitar at full fire before a Chicago crowd — one of the greatest live blues records; King won the 2004 Polar Prize.

items.title: 处女航
items.creator: Herbie Hancock
items.note: 每首曲子都以海洋命名，调式与空灵和声让整张专辑像一张海图。
items.noteEn: Every tune named for the sea — modal washes that chart an ocean voyage.

items.title: 奥蒂斯蓝调
items.creator: Otis Redding
items.note: 一天之内录完的灵魂巅峰，把翻唱与原创一起烧成南部热浪。
items.noteEn: A soul peak recorded in a single day, originals and covers scorching with Southern heat.

items.title: 布鲁斯破坏者（与克莱普顿）
items.creator: John Mayall & The Bluesbreakers
items.note: 把芝加哥蓝调带回英国并催生「克莱普顿是上帝」涂鸦，英式布鲁斯摇滚由此发端。
items.noteEn: It imported Chicago blues to Britain and spawned 'Clapton is God' — British blues-rock begins.

items.title: 最后的作品
items.creator: Violeta Parra
items.note: 智利民谣之母的绝笔，《Gracias a la vida》的诞生地。
items.noteEn: The Chilean folk matriarch's final songs — where 'Gracias a la vida' was born.

items.title: 左轮手枪
items.creator: The Beatles
items.note: 反卷带、西塔琴与磁带循环齐上阵，披头士从偶像乐队走向录音室实验室的分水岭。
items.noteEn: Backwards tapes, sitar and tape loops turn the Beatles from pop idols into studio scientists.

items.title: 黄金三镖客
items.en: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (Original Soundtrack)
items.creator: Ennio Morricone
items.note: 口哨、电吉他与人声合唱，莫里康内把西部片配乐变成艺术。
items.noteEn: Whistles, electric guitar and choral shouts — Morricone turned Western scoring into art.

items.title: 你经历过了吗
items.creator: The Jimi Hendrix Experience
items.note: 首张专辑就把电吉他的语言改写：反馈、哇音与那首〈Purple Haze〉。
items.noteEn: A debut that rewrote the electric guitar's grammar — feedback, wah and "Purple Haze."

items.title: 生于坏兆头
items.creator: Albert King
items.note: 同名曲的连奏与标题成了布鲁斯文化梗，是电声蓝调后期的代表作。
items.noteEn: The title riff and phrase became blues shorthand — late-period electric blues at its peak.

items.title: 我从未如此爱过一个男人
items.en: I Never Loved a Man the Way I Love You
items.creator: Aretha Franklin
items.note: Aretha 在 Atlantic 的首张专辑，〈Respect〉从此成为权利与尊严的国歌。
items.noteEn: Aretha's Atlantic debut — "Respect" became an anthem of rights and dignity forever.

items.title: 十一月的脚步
items.creator: Tōru Takemitsu
items.note: 为琵琶、尺八与管弦乐团而作，东方乐器与西方乐队的音色对话充满空间感。
items.noteEn: Biwa, shakuhachi and orchestra converse — Eastern timbres in a spacious Western frame.

items.title: 帕塔帕塔
items.creator: Miriam Makeba
items.note: 非洲母亲让流行乐有了第一个非洲韵律出口。
items.noteEn: Mama Africa gave pop its first great African-rhythm export.

items.title: 佩珀军士的孤独之心俱乐部乐队
items.en: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
items.creator: The Beatles
items.note: 第一张把录音室当作创作乐器的「概念专辑」，为 60 年代末的听觉野心立下标准。
items.noteEn: The first concept album to treat the studio as an instrument, setting the sonic ambition of the late '60s.

items.title: 莱昂纳德·科恩之歌
items.creator: Leonard Cohen
items.note: 《Suzanne》与诗人的低音，把文学性带进民谣的深渊。
items.noteEn: With 'Suzanne', the poet's bass-baritone dropped literature into folk's depths.

items.title: 地下丝绒与妮可
items.creator: The Velvet Underground
items.note: 当年几乎卖不动，却启发了无数乐队——关于药、性与噪音的坦白被时间正名。
items.noteEn: Sold next to nothing yet inspired countless bands — time vindicated this unflinching, noisy debut.

items.title: 福尔松监狱现场
items.creator: Johnny Cash
items.note: 在囚犯面前录制的现场专辑，把乡村乐带回它的阶级根源。
items.noteEn: Recorded before inmates, it returned country to its class roots.

items.title: 卡埃塔诺·维洛索
items.creator: Caetano Veloso
items.note: Tropicália 宣言专辑之一，用实验搅动巴西流行乐。
items.noteEn: A Tropicália manifesto that stirred Brazilian pop with experimentation.

items.title: 奥德赛与神谕
items.creator: The Zombies
items.note: 巴洛克流行遗珠，发行即被忽视，多年后〈Time of the Season〉让它成为经典。
items.noteEn: A baroque-pop gem ignored at release, resurrected when "Time of the Season" finally charted.

items.title: 变种人
items.creator: Os Mutantes
items.note: 迷幻之声与巴西节奏的嫁接，Tropicália 最狂野的一极。
items.noteEn: Psychedelia grafted onto Brazilian rhythm — the wildest pole of Tropicália.

items.title: 白色专辑
items.creator: The Beatles
items.note: 三十首歌的私人拼贴，四人的个性裂痕本身就是这张专辑真正的主题。
items.noteEn: Thirty songs as a private collage — the four personalities drifting apart become the album's own subject.

items.title: 艾比路
items.creator: The Beatles
items.note: 第二面那组无懈可击的组曲，是录音室精密度与旋律天赋的最后一次完美合体。
items.noteEn: The seamless side-two medley is the final perfect union of studio craft and melodic genius.

items.title: 寂静之路
items.creator: Miles Davis
items.note: 电子键盘与两把电吉他的绵长织体，预告了爵士摇滚的融合时代。
items.noteEn: Long electric textures from keyboards and two guitars — fusion's quiet dawn.

items.title: 业报
items.creator: Pharoah Sanders
items.note: 《The Creator Has a Master Plan》32分钟的自由赞歌，精神爵士的顶点之一。
items.noteEn: A 32-minute free-jazz hymn — the summit of spiritual jazz.

items.title: 汤斯·范·赞特
items.creator: Townes Van Zandt
items.note: 被低估的吟游诗人，《Pancho and Lefty》是他留给世界的情书。
items.noteEn: The under-sung troubadour whose 'Pancho and Lefty' is a love letter to the world.

items.title: 黄河钢琴协奏曲
items.creator: 殷承宗等
items.note: 取材冼星海《黄河大合唱》，钢琴与乐队的对抗如黄河怒涛，是革命年代的音乐图腾。
items.noteEn: Drawn from the Yellow River Cantata — piano versus orchestra as a torrent of revolution.

items.title: 泼妇之酿
items.creator: Miles Davis
items.note: 把录音室剪辑当作创作手段的电气化即兴，获得格莱美最佳爵士团体演奏。
items.noteEn: Electrified jamming edited into structure — it won the Grammy for Best Jazz Group Performance.

items.title: 忧愁河上的金桥
items.creator: Simon & Garfunkel
items.note: 同名主打是流行乐史上最动人的二重唱之一，解散前的谢幕，格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: Its title track is one of pop's most moving duets — a farewell that won the Grammy Album of the Year.

items.title: 甜心詹姆斯
items.creator: James Taylor
items.note: 《Fire and Rain》把歌手-创作人运动推向主流。
items.noteEn: 'Fire and Rain' carried the singer-songwriter movement mainstream.

items.title: 农夫之茶
items.creator: Cat Stevens
items.note: 《Wild World》与《Father and Son》，70 年代最温柔的哲学民谣。
items.noteEn: With 'Wild World' and 'Father and Son', the gentlest philosophizing of 70s folk.

items.title: 蓝色
items.creator: Joni Mitchell
items.note: 自我剖白的极致，把心碎唱成冰蓝色的透明。
items.noteEn: The apogee of confession, singing heartbreak in crystalline blue.

items.title: 萨奇达南达之旅
items.creator: Alice Coltrane
items.note: 竖琴与印度坦布拉琴织成冥想之声，艾丽斯的音乐早已超越了「爵士」标签。
items.noteEn: Harp and tambura weave a meditative drone — music that outgrows the jazz label.

items.title: 齐柏林飞艇四
items.creator: Led Zeppelin
items.note: 无标题专辑，却靠〈Stairway to Heaven〉成为重型摇滚的原型教科书。
items.noteEn: An untitled record that became heavy rock's founding text via "Stairway to Heaven."

items.title: 织锦
items.creator: Carole King
items.note: 《It's Too Late》——从幕后写手到前台歌后的转型范本，格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: With 'It's Too Late', the songwriter's leap to front-stage stardom; Grammy Album of the Year.

items.title: 暴乱进行时
items.creator: Sly and the Family Stone
items.note: 用失真的鼓机与低沉的 funk 讲出理想幻灭，比同时代的任何专辑都更阴郁。
items.noteEn: Distorted drums and low-slung funk about disillusionment — gloomier than almost anything of its time.

items.title: 怎么了
items.creator: Marvin Gaye
items.note: 第一张把越战、环保与都市绝望唱进灵魂乐的概念专辑，黑人的时代省思。
items.noteEn: The first soul concept album addressing Vietnam, ecology and urban despair — Black America's reckoning.

items.title: 下一个是谁
items.creator: The Who
items.note: 〈Baba O'Riley〉的合成器律动与〈Behind Blue Eyes〉的脆弱，撑起硬摇滚的抒情边界。
items.noteEn: The synth pulse of "Baba O'Riley" and the fragility of "Behind Blue Eyes" stretch hard rock's emotional range.

items.title: 奇异恩典
items.creator: Aretha Franklin
items.note: 在洛杉矶教堂实况录制的福音现场，被公认为史上最伟大的福音专辑之一。
items.noteEn: A live gospel recording in an LA church — widely ranked among the greatest live gospel albums ever.

items.title: 流亡大街
items.creator: The Rolling Stones
items.note: 在法国流亡别墅地下室录成的双专辑，蓝调与摇滚最脏也最性感的交织。
items.noteEn: A double album cut in a French exile basement — the Stones at their grittiest, bluesiest best.

items.title: 丰收
items.creator: Neil Young
items.note: 《Heart of Gold》与乡谣弦乐，木吉他叙事与时代挽歌并存。
items.noteEn: With 'Heart of Gold', rustic acoustic country meets an era's elegy.

items.title: 粉月
items.creator: Nick Drake
items.note: 仅以人声与吉他录制的告别，忧郁到近乎透明。
items.noteEn: Recorded with just voice and guitar — a farewell so melancholy it turns translucent.

items.title: 会说话的书
items.creator: Stevie Wonder
items.note: 〈Superstition〉的 Clavinet 律动成为放克灵魂的教科书段落。
items.noteEn: "Superstition"'s clavinet riff became a textbook passage in funk-soul rhythm.

items.title: 教父
items.creator: Nino Rota
items.note: 西西里小调的弦乐，让黑帮史诗有了宿命的温柔。
items.noteEn: Sicilian-inflected strings lent the mafia epic a fatal tenderness.

items.title: 齐格星尘的兴衰
items.en: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars
items.creator: David Bowie
items.note: 虚构外星摇滚巨星 Ziggy 的末日叙事，把舞台人格彻底写进摇滚史。
items.noteEn: The end-of-world story of fictional alien rock star Ziggy, making persona itself an art form.

items.title: 源头与水流
items.creator: Paco de Lucía
items.note: 《Entre dos aguas》让弗拉门戈吉他与爵士即兴握手。
items.noteEn: With 'Entre dos aguas', flamenco guitar shook hands with jazz improvisation.

items.title: 猎头者
items.creator: Herbie Hancock
items.note: 《Chameleon》的放克贝斯线与合成器，让爵士放克进入大众视野。
items.noteEn: Chameleon's funk bass and synths took jazz-funk to a mass audience.

items.title: 细野之家
items.creator: 细野晴臣
items.note: 细野晴臣用低保真乡谣开启 Exotica 与民谣的私人宇宙。
items.noteEn: Haruomi Hosono's lo-fi folk home-studio universe that seeded Japanese exotica.

items.title: 内在视觉
items.creator: Stevie Wonder
items.note: 合成器与政治自觉同时成熟的杰作，〈Living for the City〉是他的叙事巅峰。
items.noteEn: Synths and political consciousness maturing together — "Living for the City" at his narrative peak.

items.title: 冰的世界
items.creator: 井上阳水
items.note: 日本唱片史首张销量破百万的专辑，井上阳水以民谣与意象统治七十年代。
items.noteEn: Japan's first million-selling album; Yōsui Inoue's folk-poetry ruled the early 70s.

items.title: 轻如羽毛
items.creator: Chick Corea & Return to Forever
items.note: 《Spain》把弗拉门戈与爵士和声结合，是融合时代最轻盈优美的门面。
items.noteEn: Spain folds flamenco into jazz harmony — fusion's airiest, loveliest calling card.

items.title: 太空即此地
items.creator: Sun Ra
items.note: 太阳神方舟拉的非洲未来主义宣言，电子琴与异域和声营造出宇宙剧场的错觉。
items.noteEn: Afrofuturism avant la lettre — synths and exotic harmonies stage an interstellar revue.

items.title: 月之暗面
items.en: The Dark Side of the Moon
items.creator: Pink Floyd
items.note: 把摇滚做成工程级精密的概念专辑，在公告牌榜上驻留了惊人的 900 多周。
items.noteEn: Rock built with engineering precision — a concept album that spent over 900 weeks on the Billboard chart.

items.title: 歌剧院之夜
items.creator: Queen
items.note: 〈Bohemian Rhapsody〉把歌剧、民谣与金属缝进一首六分钟单曲，是录音室挥霍的胜利。
items.noteEn: "Bohemian Rhapsody" sews opera, ballad and metal into one six-minute single — profligacy as triumph.

items.title: 路上的血迹
items.creator: Bob Dylan
items.note: 离婚阴霾下的叙事巅峰，Dylan 把私生活写成美国神话。
items.noteEn: Dylan's narrative peak under the shadow of divorce, turning private pain into American myth.

items.title: 生为奔跑
items.creator: Bruce Springsteen
items.note: 「今晚我们奔向胜利」的逃逸宣言，把新泽西的蓝领渴望谱成摇滚国歌。
items.noteEn: An anthem of escape and working-class longing, turning New Jersey into rock's promised land.

items.title: 昂贵的屎
items.creator: Fela Kuti
items.note: Afrobeat 之父的录音室名盘，把政治讽刺与十人铜管熔成一炉。
items.noteEn: The Afrobeat pioneer's studio classic, fusing political satire with a ten-piece horn section.

items.title: 科隆音乐会
items.creator: Keith Jarrett
items.note: 在劣质钢琴上即兴出的抒情长河，史上最畅销的爵士钢琴独奏录音。
items.noteEn: An improvised lyric river on a substandard piano — the best-selling solo jazz piano record.

items.title: 愿你在此
items.creator: Pink Floyd
items.note: 献给迷失在名利场的前队友 Syd Barrett，〈Shine On You Crazy Diamond〉是摇滚最动人的悼词之一。
items.noteEn: An elegy for lost bandmate Syd Barrett — "Shine On You Crazy Diamond" is rock's most moving farewell.

items.title: 抵达
items.creator: ABBA
items.note: 〈Dancing Queen〉就在这张里，把瑞典的旋律工业推向全球。
items.noteEn: Home of "Dancing Queen" — the record that made Sweden's melody machine global.

items.title: 海滩上的爱因斯坦
items.creator: Philip Glass
items.note: 与罗伯特·威尔逊合作的五小时歌剧，数字、字母与重复音型剥离了传统叙事。
items.noteEn: A five-hour opera with Robert Wilson — numbers, letters and repetition strip away narrative.

items.title: 学习桑巴
items.creator: Tom Zé
items.note: 被大卫·伯恩重新发现的巴西怪才，用解构桑巴预演未来。
items.noteEn: Rediscovered by David Byrne, Tom Zé deconstructed samba into a preview of the future.

items.title: 十八位音乐家的音乐
items.creator: Steve Reich
items.note: 由11个和弦驱动整场约一小时的脉动，简约主义用最小材料造出最大推进感，莱希2007年获极地音乐奖。
items.noteEn: Eleven chords drive a pulsing hour — minimalism's fullest statement; Reich won the 2007 Polar Prize.

items.title: 氧气
items.creator: Jean-Michel Jarre
items.note: 全模拟合成器做成的法国电子原声带，全球销量超 1500 万张。
items.noteEn: French electronic score built entirely on analogue synths — over 15 million copies sold worldwide.

items.title: 生命之钥
items.en: Songs in the Key of Life
items.creator: Stevie Wonder
items.note: 双碟的流行灵魂百科全书，1977 年格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: A double-album encyclopedia of pop-soul, Grammy Album of the Year 1977.

items.title: 第三交响曲「悲痛之歌」
items.creator: Henryk Górecki
items.note: 三个慢乐章用波兰圣母祷文与集中营刻字，1992年的录音意外成为畅销奇迹。
items.noteEn: Three slow movements on Polish prayers and a prison-wall inscription — a 1992 chart surprise.

items.title: 更猛
items.creator: Muddy Waters
items.note: 约翰尼·温特制作的电声蓝调回春之作，获1978年格莱美传统民谣类大奖。
items.noteEn: Johnny Winter-produced comeback electricity — the 1978 Grammy-winning Traditional Folk Album.

items.title: 坏天气
items.creator: Weather Report
items.note: 《Birdland》的复合节奏与雅各布的电贝斯，融合爵士的旗舰专辑。
items.noteEn: Birdland's odd meters and Jaco's bass — the fusion flagship.

items.title: 低迷
items.creator: David Bowie
items.note: 柏林三部曲之首，把断裂的器乐与冰冷的合成器拼在一起，预示了后朋克与氛围。
items.noteEn: First of the Berlin trilogy, splicing broken instrumentals with cold synths — a blueprint for post-punk and ambient.

items.title: 谣言
items.creator: Fleetwood Mac
items.note: 乐队成员集体分手的产物，把私密伤痛做成软摇滚最精致的流行机器。
items.noteEn: Forged from the band's collective breakups, it polished private pain into the sleekest pop-rock machine of the '70s.

items.title: 星球大战：新希望
items.en: Star Wars: A New Hope (Original Soundtrack)
items.creator: John Williams
items.note: 开场号角定义了太空歌剧的听觉想象，奥斯卡最佳原创配乐。
items.noteEn: The opening fanfare defined how space opera should sound; Academy Award-winning score.

items.title: 欧洲特快列车
items.creator: Kraftwerk
items.note: 用节拍器般的电子脉冲模拟列车之旅，彻底改写了流行乐对「机械」的想象。
items.noteEn: Simulating a train journey with metronomic pulses, it rewired pop's imagination of the machine.

items.title: 机场音乐
items.creator: Brian Eno
items.note: Eno 定义「氛围音乐」的开山之作，为机场候机厅设计出可忽略又动人的背景。
items.noteEn: The founding text of ambient — music designed to be ignorable yet affecting, first for an airport lobby.

items.title: 人机
items.creator: Kraftwerk
items.note: 机器人穿西装唱歌的封面，是「人机合一」美学最直接的宣言。
items.noteEn: Robots in suits on the cover — the most literal statement of the man-machine aesthetic.

items.title: 千之刃
items.creator: 坂本龙一
items.note: 坂本龙一将电子乐与亚欧传统素材并置，学院派的先锋起点。
items.noteEn: Ryuichi Sakamoto fusing electronics with Asian and European traditions — an academician's avant-garde debut.

items.title: 伦敦呼叫
items.creator: The Clash
items.note: 朋克没有限制他们的愤怒，反而让他们写进雷鬼、放克与摇滚混合的双专辑。
items.noteEn: Punk didn't limit their rage — it let them splice reggae, funk and rock into a double album.

items.title: 墙外
items.creator: Michael Jackson
items.note: 与 Quincy Jones 的首次合作，把迪斯科、放克与灵魂乐熔成成人流行的模板。
items.noteEn: First collaboration with Quincy Jones, fusing disco, funk and soul into the template for adult pop.

items.title: 橄榄树
items.creator: 齐豫
items.note: 三毛作词的《橄榄树》让齐豫的声音成为台湾民歌运动的化身。
items.noteEn: With lyrics by Sanmao, 'Olive Tree' made Chyi Yu's voice the embodiment of Taiwan's folk-song movement.

items.title: Solid State Survivor
items.creator: Yellow Magic Orchestra
items.note: YMO 第二张专辑，把 Techno 流行化的世界宣言，《Behind the Mask》走向全球。
items.noteEn: YMO's second LP turned techno into pop and sent 'Behind the Mask' around the world.

items.title: 迷墙
items.creator: Pink Floyd
items.note: 把心墙筑成双专辑歌剧，疏离、战争与疯狂在每一块砖里膨胀。
items.noteEn: A double-album opera about alienation, war and madness, brick by brick.

items.title: 未知的欢愉
items.creator: Joy Division
items.note: 那张脉冲星封面与 Ian Curtis 的深渊低吟，共同定义了后朋克的冷。
items.noteEn: A pulsar cover and Ian Curtis's abyssal baritone defined the cold of post-punk.

items.title: 回到黑暗
items.creator: AC/DC
items.note: 在故主 Bon Scott 离世后以新主唱重生，成为史上最畅销的摇滚专辑之一。
items.noteEn: Reborn with a new singer after Bon Scott's death — one of the best-selling rock albums ever.

items.title: 第四世界卷一：可能的音乐
items.creator: Jon Hassell & Brian Eno
items.note: 小号的「第四世界」理论——把世界各地的素材融化进数字延迟的雾中。
items.noteEn: Trumpet through digital delay — 'Fourth World' music, global sources in a haze.

items.title: 留在光明中
items.creator: Talking Heads
items.note: 把非洲放克律动塞进后朋克骨架，循环采样让乐队听起来像一支不断增殖的方阵。
items.noteEn: African funk polyrhythms in a post-punk chassis — looping samples make the band feel like a multiplying ensemble.

items.title: 丝绸之路
items.creator: 喜多郎
items.note: 为NHK纪录片所作，合成器描摹驼铃与沙漠，是日本新世纪音乐走向世界的名片。
items.noteEn: Synthesizers evoke caravans and dunes for an NHK series — Japanese New Age goes global.

items.title: 镜之高地
items.creator: Harold Budd & Brian Eno
items.note: 钢琴与电子延音的极简对话，像雨后山谷里的回响。
items.noteEn: Minimal piano over electronic sustain — an echo in a rain-washed valley.

items.title: A Long Vacation
items.creator: 大泷咏一
items.note: 大泷咏一的盛夏概念专辑，City Pop 命名的重要源头之一。
items.noteEn: Ōtaki's midsummer concept album and one of the wellsprings of the 'city pop' name.

items.title: 烈火战车
items.creator: Vangelis
items.note: 合成器主题与慢镜头奔跑绑定，1982年获奥斯卡最佳原创配乐。
items.noteEn: The synth theme IS the slow-motion run — winner of the 1982 Academy Award for Best Score.

items.title: 银翼杀手
items.creator: Vangelis
items.note: 合成器描绘的霓虹雨夜，赛博朋克配乐的模板。
items.noteEn: Synths painting a neon rain — the template of cyberpunk scoring.

items.title: For You
items.creator: 山下达郎
items.note: City Pop 的教科书，夏季海岸与合成器的完美共振。
items.noteEn: A textbook of city pop — the perfect resonance of summer coasts and synths.

items.title: 颤栗
items.creator: Michael Jackson
items.note: 史上最畅销专辑之一，七首 Top 10 单曲，把音乐录影带变成一门产业。
items.noteEn: One of the best-selling albums ever, with seven Top-10 singles — it turned the music video into an industry.

items.title: 之乎者也
items.creator: 罗大佑
items.note: 一把电吉他把文言成语砸进摇滚，被奉为台湾流行音乐百佳第一的破格之作。
items.noteEn: Anchoring classical idioms to electric rock, it is crowned No.1 in Taiwan's 100 Best Pop Albums.

items.title: 淡淡幽情
items.creator: 邓丽君
items.note: 把宋词谱曲成歌，邓丽君最「文人」的一张，词牌与气声互为表里。
items.noteEn: Setting Song-dynasty ci poetry to melody, Teresa Teng's most literary album pairs ancient lyrics with her signature breathy voice.

items.title: 圣诞快乐，劳伦斯先生
items.creator: 坂本龙一
items.note: 同名主题成为坂本龙一最著名的旋律，战争与和解的东方回响。
items.noteEn: Its title theme is Sakamoto's most famous melody — a reconciliation of East and West amid war.

items.title: 搭错车
items.en: Papa, Can You Hear Me Sing? (Original Soundtrack)
items.creator: 苏芮
items.note: 《酒干倘卖无》《一样的月光》——苏芮把西洋摇滚嗓带进华语电影配乐。
items.noteEn: With 'Wine Glasses' and 'Same Moon', Su Rui's Western rock voice electrified a Chinese film score for the first time.

items.title: 她如此不寻常
items.creator: Cyndi Lauper
items.note: 彩虹发色与〈Time After Time〉，把新浪潮气质做成畅销排行榜的主流。
items.noteEn: Rainbow hair and "Time After Time" — new-wave quirk turned into chart-topping mainstream.

items.title: 德州洪水
items.creator: Stevie Ray Vaughan & Double Trouble
items.note: 在蒙特勒现场救场后录制的首专，把布鲁斯摇滚带回吉他的中心。
items.noteEn: A debut recorded after a Montreux rescue — putting the guitar back at blues-rock's center.

items.title: 紫雨
items.creator: Prince and the Revolution
items.note: 同名电影与专辑互为注脚，〈Purple Rain〉让 Prince 成为当时代的天王，并拿下奥斯卡原创歌曲配乐奖。
items.noteEn: Album and film in dialogue — "Purple Rain" made Prince the reigning star of the era and won an Academy Award for its score.

items.title: 爱的根源
items.creator: 谭咏麟
items.note: 谭咏麟全盛期神作，奠定香港都会情歌的录音室美学。
items.noteEn: Alan Tam at his peak; a studio masterpiece that defined Hong Kong's metropolitan love-song sound.

items.title: Variety
items.creator: 竹内まりや
items.note: 《Plastic Love》的原点，被互联网重新发现的昭和都会律动。
items.noteEn: The source of 'Plastic Love', a Shōwa urban groove rediscovered by the internet.

items.title: 爱的猎犬
items.creator: Kate Bush
items.note: 〈Running Up That Hill〉把电子流行带进高概念叙事，第二面是完整的艺术歌剧。
items.noteEn: "Running Up That Hill" fuses electronic pop with high concept; side two is a complete art-opera.

items.title: 惠特妮·休斯顿
items.creator: Whitney Houston
items.note: 史上最畅销的女歌手处子专辑之一，〈Saving All My Love for You〉为她捧回第一座格莱美。
items.noteEn: One of the best-selling female debuts ever; "Saving All My Love for You" won her first Grammy.

items.title: 傀儡之主
items.creator: Metallica
items.note: 把鞭击金属的复杂编曲推到巅峰，2016 年入选美国国家录音典藏。
items.noteEn: Thrash metal's compositional peak, added to the National Recording Registry in 2016.

items.title: 掀起地狱
items.creator: Run-D.M.C.
items.note: 与 Aerosmith 合作〈Walk This Way〉，把说唱与摇滚一起推上主流电台。
items.noteEn: Teaming with Aerosmith on "Walk This Way" carried rap and rock to mainstream radio together.

items.title: 女王已死
items.creator: The Smiths
items.note: Morrissey 的机智刻薄配上 Marr 的吉他清亮，把独立流行写成反主流宣言。
items.noteEn: Morrissey's wit and Marr's gleaming guitar turn indie pop into a counter-mainstream manifesto.

items.title: 生命中的精灵
items.creator: 李宗盛
items.note: 李宗盛首张个人专辑，城市男性的心事独白，语感即是旋律。
items.noteEn: Jonathan Lee's solo debut — intimate monologues of urban men where speech rhythm becomes melody.

items.title: 零点
items.creator: Astor Piazzolla
items.note: 新探戈的宣言，手风琴在古典与爵士之间起舞。
items.noteEn: The manifesto of tango nuevo — the bandoneón dancing between classical and jazz.

items.title: 飙
items.creator: Michael Jackson
items.note: 紧接 Thriller 的连冠专辑，〈Smooth Criminal〉把舞蹈编排推向电影级。
items.noteEn: The chart-topping follow-up to Thriller — "Smooth Criminal" pushed choreography to cinematic scale.

items.title: 信念
items.creator: George Michael
items.note: 单飞后的全能宣言，包办词曲制作，〈Faith〉拿下 1988 年格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: A one-man solo statement — written, produced and performed by George Michael, Grammy Album of the Year 1988.

items.title: 即兴之声
items.creator: Zakir Hussain
items.note: 塔布拉鼓王与 Jan Garbarek、John McLaughlin 的 ECM 即兴，印度节奏与北欧萨克斯的对话。
items.noteEn: The tabla master improvising with Jan Garbarek and John McLaughlin — an ECM dialogue of Indian rhythm and Nordic sax.

items.title: 沙卡·祖鲁
items.creator: Ladysmith Black Mambazo
items.note: 祖鲁合唱与《Graceland》一同把南非声音带进西方客厅，格莱美最佳传统民谣。
items.noteEn: Zulu isicathamiya that, alongside Graceland, carried South African voices into Western homes; Grammy winner.

items.title: 石头记
items.en: Shi Tou Ji (The Story of the Stone)
items.creator: 达明一派
items.note: 以《红楼梦》入歌，电子编曲包裹文言意象，香港新浪潮的巅峰。
items.noteEn: Adapting Dream of the Red Chamber into synth-pop, it marks the zenith of Hong Kong's new-wave scene.

items.title: 时代印记
items.creator: Prince
items.note: 双碟横跨放克、民谣、摇滚与电子，是 Prince 一生创造力最湍急的河流。
items.noteEn: A double album spanning funk, balladry, rock and electronics — Prince's most torrential creative peak.

items.title: 约书亚之树
items.creator: U2
items.note: 在美国沙漠里拍出的大片感摇滚，让 U2 从都柏林乐队变成世界级命题。
items.noteEn: Cinematic rock shot in the American desert, turning U2 from Dublin band into global statement.

items.title: 末代皇帝
items.creator: 坂本龙一
items.note: 坂本龙一、大卫·伯恩与苏聪共享奥斯卡，东西配乐的水乳交融。
items.noteEn: Sakamoto, Byrne and Cong Su shared an Oscar — a seamless East-West fusion.

items.title: 天堂电影院
items.creator: Ennio Morricone
items.note: 《Love Theme》的弦乐让乡愁可触，莫里康内最柔情的旋律。
items.noteEn: The 'Love Theme''s strings make nostalgia tangible — Morricone's tenderest melody.

items.title: 白日梦国度
items.creator: Sonic Youth
items.note: 另类摇滚把调音当作创作手段的长篇宣言，影响整个九十年代的独立场景。
items.noteEn: A sprawling alt-rock manifesto treating alternate tunings as composition — the blueprint for '90s indie.

items.title: 龙猫
items.creator: 久石让
items.note: 《散步》的旋律让宫崎骏的田园魔法有了心跳。
items.noteEn: 'The Path of the Wind' gave Miyazaki's pastoral magic a heartbeat.

items.title: 沙代
items.creator: Ofra Haza
items.note: 《Im Nin'alu》把也门犹太传统与合成器流行嫁接，风靡欧洲舞池。
items.noteEn: 'Im Nin'alu' grafted Yemenite-Jewish tradition onto synth-pop and conquered European dance floors.

items.title: 水印
items.creator: Enya
items.note: 《Orinoco Flow》的多轨人声叠出空灵圣所，让新世纪音乐登上排行榜。
items.noteEn: Orinoco Flow's layered vocals built a cathedral of air — New Age on the pop charts.

items.title: Blue Blood
items.creator: X Japan
items.note: Visual Kei 的圣经，华丽金属包裹着古典钢琴的底色。
items.noteEn: The bible of visual kei — glam metal wrapped around classical piano.

items.title: 杜立德
items.creator: Pixies
items.note: 动静切换的「软-硬」范式，直接催生了 Nirvana 的 Nevermind。
items.noteEn: The loud-quiet-loud template that directly fathered Nirvana's Nevermind.

items.title: 节奏国度 1814
items.creator: Janet Jackson
items.note: 用放克节拍讲社会议题，概念与舞蹈编排都走在时代前头。
items.noteEn: Funk beats carrying social commentary — a concept and choreography years ahead of its time.

items.title: 宛如祈祷者
items.creator: Madonna
items.note: 麦当娜最私人也最大胆的一张，MV 里的宗教意象让全世界哗然。
items.noteEn: Madonna's most personal and provocative record — its religious imagery ignited global controversy.

items.title: 新长征路上的摇滚
items.en: Rock on the New Long March
items.creator: 崔健
items.note: 《一无所有》之外，崔健把迷茫与反叛焊进摇滚，中国摇滚的起点。
items.noteEn: Beyond 'Nothing to My Name', Cui Jian welded restlessness into rock — the starting point of Chinese rock.

items.title: 跟你说 听你说
items.en: Talk to You, Listen to You
items.creator: 陈淑桦
items.note: 《梦醒时分》——李宗盛操刀的都会情歌，台湾百万销量的城市蓝调。
items.noteEn: With 'Dream Awake', Jonathan Lee's urban balladry made Sarah Chen a million-selling Taipei voice.

items.title: 疗愈者
items.creator: John Lee Hooker
items.note: 与桑塔纳等合作的回归之作，1990年获格莱美最佳传统蓝调录音。
items.noteEn: A comeback with Santana and guests — the 1990 Grammy for Best Traditional Blues Recording.

items.title: 罗伯特·约翰逊全集
items.creator: Robert Johnson
items.note: 1936-37年的29首录音合辑，1991年获格莱美最佳传统蓝调专辑，是三角洲蓝调的源头。
items.noteEn: Twenty-nine 1936-37 sides collected; a 1991 Grammy winner — the delta blues at its source.

items.title: 侵犯者
items.creator: Depeche Mode
items.note: 〈Personal Jesus〉与〈Enjoy the Silence〉，把合成器流行推到教堂般庄严的高度。
items.noteEn: "Personal Jesus" and "Enjoy the Silence" lift synth-pop to cathedral solemnity.

items.title: 黑豹
items.creator: 黑豹乐队
items.note: 《Don't Break My Heart》让摇滚第一次进入内地主流视野。
items.noteEn: 'Don't Break My Heart' brought rock into China's mainstream consciousness.

items.title: 蓝线
items.creator: Massive Attack
items.note: 被追认为「Trip-Hop」的起点，把缓拍、爵士采样与说唱揉成一团烟雾。
items.noteEn: Retroactively the birthplace of trip-hop — slow beats, jazz samples and rap dissolved into smoke.

items.title: 没错，我有蓝调
items.en: Damn Right, I've Got the Blues
items.creator: Buddy Guy
items.note: 芝加哥传奇重出江湖，1992年获格莱美最佳当代蓝调专辑。
items.noteEn: A Chicago legend returns in form — the 1992 Grammy for Best Contemporary Blues Album.

items.title: 微笑
items.creator: Sezen Aksu
items.note: 土耳其乐坛女王的转折之作，阿拉伯花腔与流行乐的结合。
items.noteEn: The Turkish queen's pivotal record, fusing arabesque melisma with pop.

items.title: 别在意
items.creator: Nirvana
items.note: 把另类摇滚砸进主流视野的爆炸性专辑，〈Smells Like Teen Spirit〉改写了一代人的音量。
items.noteEn: The record that detonated alternative rock into the mainstream, rewiring a generation's volume.

items.title: 低音端理论
items.creator: A Tribe Called Quest
items.note: 把爵士贝斯与清醒的韵律接在一起，奠定了「另类说唱」的语法。
items.noteEn: Jazz bass and a lucid flow — the record that codified alternative rap's grammar.

items.title: 为人民自动
items.creator: R.E.M.
items.note: 近乎民谣的安静内省之作，〈Nightswimming〉把乡愁拍成黑白胶片。
items.noteEn: Quiet, near-folk introspection — "Nightswimming" develops nostalgia like a roll of black-and-white film.

items.title: 深林
items.creator: Deep Forest
items.note: 把喀麦隆俾格米人采样放进电子节拍，1995年获格莱美最佳世界音乐专辑。
items.noteEn: Cameroonian Pygmy samples inside dance beats — the 1995 Grammy for Best World Music Album.

items.title: 精选环境作品85-92
items.creator: Aphex Twin
items.note: 用极简合成器音色把氛围与节拍缝在一起，让卧室制作成为一门艺术。
items.noteEn: Stitching ambient and beat-driven electronics from minimal synth tones, it made bedroom production an art.

items.title: 徐太志和孩子们
items.creator: 徐太志和孩子们
items.note: 《Nan Arayo》引爆韩国乐坛地震，K-Pop 真正的创世纪。
items.noteEn: With 'I Know', Seo Taiji's debut shook Korea — the true genesis of K-pop.

items.title: 唐朝
items.creator: 唐朝乐队
items.note: 《梦回唐朝》以重金属书写盛唐气象，中国摇滚最壮阔的想象。
items.noteEn: Heavy-metal grandeur conjuring the Tang dynasty — Chinese rock's most epic vision.

items.title: 慢性
items.creator: Dr. Dre
items.note: G-funk 的奠基之作，慢速放克采样让西海岸说唱找到了标志性的「慵懒」。
items.noteEn: The founding document of G-funk — slowed funk samples gave West Coast rap its signature lope.

items.title: 不插电
items.creator: Eric Clapton
items.note: 《Layla》被改成原声慢板，1993年包揽六项格莱美含年度专辑。
items.noteEn: An unplugged Layla reimagined — six Grammys in 1993, including Album of the Year.

items.title: 狗样
items.creator: Snoop Dogg
items.note: Snoop 松弛的唱腔配上 G-funk，让说唱听起来像一种毫不费力的生活方式。
items.noteEn: Snoop's laid-back drawl over G-funk made rap sound like an effortless lifestyle.

items.title: 武当派入门（三十六房）
items.creator: Wu-Tang Clan
items.note: 把武侠片采样、粗糙节拍与九人团体变成东海岸的一支民兵队。
items.noteEn: Martial-arts samples, raw beats and a nine-man crew as an East Coast militia.

items.title: 乐与怒
items.creator: Beyond
items.note: 收录《海阔天空》，黄家驹离世前的绝唱，理想主义者的墓志铭。
items.noteEn: Housing 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies', it stands as Wong Ka-kui's final testament before his death.

items.title: 辛德勒的名单
items.creator: John Williams
items.note: 伊扎克·帕尔曼的小提琴如泣如诉，大屠杀最哀恸的旋律，奥斯卡配乐。
items.noteEn: Itzhak Perlman's violin weeps through the Holocaust's most mournful theme; Oscar-winning score.

items.title: 吻别
items.creator: 张学友
items.note: 情歌时代的高峰，同名主打在华语圈家喻户晓，Jacky 以气声统治九十年代。
items.noteEn: The peak of the love-song era; its title track is ubiquitous across the Sinophone world and defined Jacky Cheung's 90s.

items.title: 黑梦
items.creator: 窦唯
items.note: 窦唯首张个人专辑，梦呓与鼓机营造的黑暗美学，领先时代十年。
items.noteEn: Dou Wei's solo debut, a dark dreamscape of mumbles and drum machines a decade ahead of its time.

items.title: 低音在我的脑海中
items.creator: Underworld
items.note: 把浩室、科技舞曲与即兴人声黏合成夜店圣歌，为英国锐舞时代立传。
items.noteEn: House, techno and improvised vocals fused into rave anthems — the soundtrack to UK rave culture.

items.title: 假人
items.creator: Portishead
items.note: 1995 年水星奖得主，把电影配乐的幽暗与嘻哈采样接到 Beth Gibbons 的鬼魅人声。
items.noteEn: Winner of the 1995 Mercury Prize — film-score gloom and hip-hop samples under Beth Gibbons's ghostly voice.

items.title: 图解
items.creator: Nas
items.note: 二十岁 Nas 的处子作，十首歌十位金牌制作人，说唱写作的完美范本。
items.noteEn: A twenty-year-old's debut — ten tracks, ten A-list producers, hip-hop lyricism at its purest.

items.title: 赤裸裸
items.creator: 郑钧
items.note: 《回到拉萨》与同名主打——西式摇滚与西北血脉混血的内地经典。
items.noteEn: With 'Return to Lhasa', Zheng Jun's raw fusion of Western rock and northwest-China roots.

items.title: 准备好赴死
items.creator: The Notorious B.I.G.
items.note: Biggie 用厚实的叙事流把街头苦难讲成电影，东海岸复兴的核心文献。
items.noteEn: Biggie's dense narrative flow turns street struggle into cinema — the core text of East Coast revival.

items.title: 狮子王
items.creator: Hans Zimmer
items.note: 非洲合唱与百老汇旋律合体，奥斯卡最佳原创配乐。
items.noteEn: African choral textures meet Broadway melody; Academy Award-winning score.

items.title: 孤儿挽歌
items.creator: Huun-Huur-Tu
items.note: 图瓦呼麦的喉音合唱，把草原风声装进五声音阶。
items.noteEn: Tuvan throat-singing ensemble turning steppe wind into pentatonic song.

items.title: 晨光荣耀
items.creator: Oasis
items.note: 英伦流行最大声的宣言，〈Wonderwall〉与〈Don't Look Back in Anger〉成为一代国歌。
items.noteEn: Britpop's loudest statement — "Wonderwall" and "Don't Look Back in Anger" became generational anthems.

items.title: Love, Sandy
items.creator: 林忆莲
items.note: 李宗盛为其量身打造，都市女性情歌的教科书，伤痕与缠绵并存。
items.noteEn: Tailored by Jonathan Lee, it is the textbook of urban women's ballads — wounds wrapped in tenderness.

items.title: 破城锤
items.creator: Emmylou Harris
items.note: Daniel Lanois 操刀，用氛围声景重造乡村乐，格莱美最佳当代民谣专辑。
items.noteEn: Produced by Daniel Lanois, it rebuilt country through ambient soundscapes and won a Grammy.

items.title: 众目睽睽
items.creator: 2Pac
items.note: 嘻哈史上第一张双碟全长专辑，把西海岸黑帮说唱写成宏大的自传。
items.noteEn: Hip-hop's first full-length double album, turning West Coast gangsta rap into a sprawling autobiography.

items.title: 深海
items.creator: Mr.Children
items.note: Mr.Children 最深邃的一张，把通俗摇滚做成文学。
items.noteEn: Mr.Children's deepest record, turning mass-market rock into literature.

items.title: 坠入爱河
items.creator: Celine Dion
items.note: 全球超三千万销量的抒情巨轮，为成人抒情在格莱美正名。
items.noteEn: A 30-million-selling ballad juggernaut that gave adult contemporary its Grammy vindication.

items.title: 眼中的光
items.creator: Amr Diab
items.note: 《Habibi Ya Nour El Ain》让埃及流行乐传遍中东与北非。
items.noteEn: 'Habibi Ya Nour El Ain' carried Egyptian pop across the Middle East and North Africa.

items.title: 合理怀疑
items.creator: Jay-Z
items.note: 处子作就是巅峰级黑帮叙事，冷静的弦乐采样定义了纽约九十年代的雅痞说唱。
items.noteEn: A debut at peak gangsta-narrative form — cool string samples defined '90s New York rap refinement.

items.title: 红
items.creator: 张国荣
items.note: 张国荣×林夕×C.Y.Kong 的铁三角，红是华语流行最妖冶的艺术人格。
items.noteEn: The triad of Leslie Cheung, Lin Xi and C.Y. Kong; 'Red' is the most androgynous art-persona in Mandarin pop.

items.title: 浮躁
items.creator: 王菲
items.note: 几乎全中文创作，王菲最任性的一张，梦呓式吟唱裹着北京摇滚的底色。
items.noteEn: Almost entirely self-penned, Faye Wong's most willful record, mixing dreamy scat-singing with Beijing-rock textures.

items.title: 理查德·D·詹姆斯专辑
items.creator: Aphex Twin
items.note: 复杂到近乎痉挛的节拍，把电子音乐的「精确疯狂」推到极限。
items.noteEn: Breakbeats complex to the point of spasm — electronic precision taken to the edge of madness.

items.title: 姊妹
items.creator: 张惠妹
items.note: 出道即巅峰，原住民的力量嗓音刷新华语女声标准。
items.noteEn: A debut at full power; A-Mei's indigenous-rooted voice reset the bar for Mandarin female vocals.

items.title: SWEET 19 BLUES
items.creator: 安室奈美惠
items.note: 安室 19 岁的出道告白，日本女歌手销量纪录的缔造者。
items.noteEn: Namie's coming-of-age statement at 19, setting a sales record for a solo female artist.

items.title: 乐谱
items.creator: The Fugees
items.note: 〈Killing Me Softly〉让嘻哈灵魂翻唱火遍全球，Lauryn Hill 一鸣惊人。
items.noteEn: "Killing Me Softly" took hip-hop soul worldwide and made Lauryn Hill a star overnight.

items.title: 反对一切暴力
items.en: We Hate All Kinds of Violence… (H.O.T.)
items.creator: H.O.T.
items.note: 第一代偶像男团的起点，H.O.T. 定义了 K-Pop 的粉丝工业。
items.noteEn: The start of the first-generation idol boy band, defining K-pop's fandom industry.

items.title: 巴杜主义
items.creator: Erykah Badu
items.note: 头巾与唱腔把「另类 R&B」带上主流，1998 年拿下最佳 R&B 专辑。
items.noteEn: Head-wraps and phrasing brought "alternative R&B" mainstream — Grammy Best R&B Album 1998.

items.title: 土地上的血
items.creator: Wynton Marsalis
items.note: 三小时清唱剧式的爵士长作，首部获普利策音乐奖的爵士作品。
items.noteEn: A three-hour jazz oratorio — the first jazz work to win the Pulitzer Prize for Music.

items.title: David Tao
items.creator: 陶喆
items.note: 《爱，很简单》——陶喆把美式 R&B 缝进华语歌词，宣告新派情歌。
items.noteEn: With 'Love, It's Simple', David Tao stitched American R&B into Mandarin lyrics, ushering a new pop.

items.title: 自掘坟墓
items.creator: The Chemical Brothers
items.note: Big Beat 在商业与创意上的双料巅峰，〈Block Rockin' Beats〉是仓库派对的战鼓。
items.noteEn: Big-beat's commercial and creative peak — "Block Rockin' Beats" as the warehouse war drum.

items.title: 作业
items.creator: Daft Punk
items.note: 把粗粝的芝加哥浩室与放克采样打包，定义了法国电子入侵的起点。
items.noteEn: Raw Chicago house and funk samples packed into a debut that launched the French electronic invasion.

items.title: 同质
items.creator: Björk
items.note: 弦乐与节拍撞击出冰岛式的冷艳，〈Jóga〉是她最锋利的一张名片。
items.noteEn: Strings colliding with beats in Icelandic cold beauty — "Jóga" is her sharpest calling card.

items.title: 口是心非
items.creator: 张雨生
items.note: 张雨生最后的完整作品，编曲繁复的摇滚概念专辑，翌年追授金曲奖最佳专辑。
items.noteEn: Chang Yu-sheng's final full album — an intricately arranged rock statement that took the Golden Melody Best Album a year later.

items.title: OK 电脑
items.creator: Radiohead
items.note: 用吉他、电子脉冲与不安的歌词预演了千禧年的疏离，屡被票选为九十年代最佳专辑。
items.noteEn: Guitar, electronic pulses and paranoid lyrics foretold millennial alienation — repeatedly crowned the '90s' best album.

items.title: 土地的肥脂
items.creator: The Prodigy
items.note: 〈Smack My Bitch Up〉与〈Firestarter〉把电子乐的狂暴带进主流体育场。
items.noteEn: "Smack My Bitch Up" and "Firestarter" carried electronic rage into the mainstream arena.

items.title: 水瓶与双子
items.creator: OutKast
items.note: 南方的怪诞灵魂乐与说唱在亚特兰大相遇，〈Rosa Parks〉让它进入流行视野。
items.noteEn: Southern weirdness, soul and rap meeting in Atlanta — "Rosa Parks" pushed it into the mainstream.

items.title: 砾石路上的车轮
items.en: Car Wheels on a Gravel Road
items.creator: Lucinda Williams
items.note: 八年的打磨换来南方叙事的琥珀，格莱美最佳当代民谣专辑。
items.noteEn: Eight years of polish yielding amber Southern narratives; Grammy Best Contemporary Folk Album.

items.title: 征服
items.creator: 那英
items.note: 那英北派大气嗓的国民代表作，同名主打唱进 KTV 殿堂。
items.noteEn: Na Ying's signature big-voice anthem, a national hit that became a karaoke staple.

items.title: 夹层
items.creator: Massive Attack
items.note: 〈Teardrop〉的冰冷吟唱配上吉他失真，让 Trip-Hop 走向暗黑与宏大。
items.noteEn: The cold vocal of "Teardrop" over distorted guitar — trip-hop grown dark and monumental.

items.title: 月球旅行
items.creator: Air
items.note: 法式闲适电子的代表作，〈Sexy Boy〉让「轻松」成为九十年代末的奢侈。
items.noteEn: The sound of French nonchalance — "Sexy Boy" made effortlessness the luxury of the late '90s.

items.title: 音乐有权属于孩子
items.en: Music Has the Right to Children
items.creator: Boards of Canada
items.note: 用老旧合成器与教育影片采样制造「童年记忆的失真」，IDM 的乡愁鼻祖。
items.noteEn: Old synths and educational-film samples as corrupted childhood memory — IDM's nostalgic origin.

items.title: 光芒万丈
items.creator: Madonna
items.note: 与 William Orbit 合作的电子流行转向，也是麦当娜的灵性转折点。
items.noteEn: A William Orbit-produced turn into electronic pop — and Madonna's spiritual reinvention.

items.title: 公转自转
items.creator: 王力宏
items.note: 王力宏凭此拿下金曲奖最佳男演唱人，美式唱作站稳华语。
items.noteEn: Wang Leehom's Golden Melody-winning Best Male Vocalist record planted American songwriting in Mandopop.

items.title: 劳伦·希尔的教育
items.creator: Lauryn Hill
items.note: 首位凭说唱专辑拿下格莱美年度专辑的女性，灵魂、雷鬼与嘻哈一体。
items.noteEn: The first woman to win Album of the Year for a rap album — soul, reggae and hip-hop as one.

items.creator: Dr. Dre
items.note: 启用 Eminem 与 Snoop 的跨世纪制作大秀，〈Still D.R.E.〉是西海岸的加冕礼。
items.noteEn: A millennial production showcase launching Eminem — "Still D.R.E." as West Coast coronation.

items.title: First Love
items.creator: 宇多田光
items.note: 日本史上销量最高的专辑，15 岁的宇多田光定义了平成 R&B 流行。
items.noteEn: Japan's best-selling album ever; a 15-year-old Utada defined Heisei R&B pop.

items.title: 我去2000年
items.creator: 朴树
items.note: 《那些花儿》《白桦林》——千禧前夕内地独立流行的青春碑。
items.noteEn: With 'Those Flowers' and 'Birch Forest', it is the monument of pre-millennium Chinese indie pop.

items.title: 无罪偿债期
items.creator: 椎名林檎
items.note: 椎名林檎的病娇美学与涩谷系编曲，J-Pop 最异色的天才登场。
items.noteEn: Shiina Ringo's debut — her ailing-girlish aesthetics and Shibuya-kei arrangements announced a singular genius.

items.title: 卧虎藏龙
items.creator: 谭盾
items.note: 马友友的大提琴与东方打击乐对话，华人首座奥斯卡最佳配乐。
items.noteEn: Yo-Yo Ma's cello dialogues with Chinese percussion — the first Chinese Academy Award for score.

items.title: 一号复制人
items.creator: Radiohead
items.note: 抛弃吉他摇滚，用鼓机、采样与扭曲人声重建一个冰河纪的听觉景观。
items.noteEn: Ditching guitars for drum machines, samples and mangled vocals, Radiohead rebuilt a glacial landscape.

items.title: 还是会寂寞
items.creator: 陈绮贞
items.note: 陈绮贞第二张，把吉他民谣做成文艺青年的身份徽章。
items.noteEn: Cheer Chen's second album turned guitar folk into the badge of a generation's literary youth.

items.title: 孙燕姿
items.creator: 孙燕姿
items.note: 《天黑黑》——新加坡短发女孩用清亮中音横扫华语乐坛。
items.noteEn: With 'Dark Sky', the short-haired Singaporean swept the Sinophone charts with a crystalline mid-range.

items.title: 那一年
items.creator: 许巍
items.note: 许巍从地下摇滚转向温暖民谣的转折点，吉他声如秋天。
items.noteEn: Xu Wei's pivot from underground rock to warm balladry, with guitars that feel like autumn.

items.title: 马歇尔·马瑟斯专辑
items.creator: Eminem
items.note: 把自传式的愤怒与恶趣味做成世纪之交最畅销的说唱专辑之一。
items.noteEn: Autobiographical rage and bad taste — one of the best-selling rap albums of the era.

items.title: 巫毒
items.creator: D'Angelo
items.note: 现场乐队录制的「新灵魂乐」杰作，〈Untitled (How Does It Feel)〉让 MTV 一度瘫痪。
items.noteEn: A neo-soul masterpiece cut live in the studio — "Untitled (How Does It Feel)" froze MTV.

items.title: 发现
items.creator: Daft Punk
items.note: 用采样把七十年代迪斯科变成未来主义流行，〈One More Time〉是全球舞池的共同记忆。
items.noteEn: Sampling '70s disco into futuristic pop — "One More Time" is dance music's shared memory.

items.title: 范特西
items.creator: 周杰伦
items.note: 双截棍、爱在西元前、安静——一张专辑定义华语 R&B 的黄金范式，金曲奖最佳专辑。
items.noteEn: With 'Nunchucks' and 'Love Before A.D.', one album set the golden template for Mandarin R&B.

items.title: 千与千寻
items.creator: 久石让
items.note: 《那个夏天》与《第六号站台》，久石让为东方幻想配乐立下标杆。
items.noteEn: With 'That Summer' and 'The Sixth Station', Hisaishi set the bar for East-Asian fantasy scoring.

items.title: 蓝图
items.creator: Jay-Z
items.note: 在 9·11 当周发行，Kanye 制作的灵魂采样节拍让 Jay-Z 找到中年后的自信。
items.noteEn: Released the week of 9/11, Kanye's soul-sampled beats gave Jay-Z a new, assured maturity.

items.title: 指环王：护戒使者
items.en: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (Original Soundtrack)
items.creator: Howard Shore
items.note: 霍华德·肖用庞大的主题矩阵为托尔金世界立传，奥斯卡配乐。
items.noteEn: Howard Shore's vast leitmotif architecture gave Tolkien's world its epic voice; Oscar-winning.

items.title: 昼伏夜出
items.creator: Björk
items.note: 把竖琴、冰晶般的音色与耳语人声做成冬日情书，私密到令人屏息。
items.noteEn: Harps, crystalline textures and whispered vocals as a winter love letter — intimate enough to hold your breath.

items.title: 美国 IV：人终将逝去
items.en: American IV: The Man Comes Around
items.creator: Johnny Cash
items.note: 病榻前的翻唱绝唱，一曲《Hurt》的苍凉让一代人重新认识死亡。
items.noteEn: A cover masterwork from the sickbed; 'Hurt' taught a generation about mortality.

items.title: 消解循环
items.creator: William Basinski
items.note: 一盘正在氧化老化的磁带循环逐渐剥落，被听作911事件当天的悼亡。
items.noteEn: A decaying tape loop slowly disintegrates — heard as an elegy for 9/11.

items.title: 黑白灰
items.creator: 陈奕迅
items.note: 《十年》《兄妹》——Eason 用三色概念划分都市情感的三种灰。
items.noteEn: With 'Ten Years' and 'Brother & Sister', Eason maps urban emotion in three shades.

items.title: 看我72变
items.creator: 蔡依林
items.note: Jolin 转型唱跳天后之作，舞曲美学正式接管华语女歌手。
items.noteEn: Jolin's reinvention into a dance diva — club-ready pop took over Mandarin female stardom.

items.title: 轮舞
items.creator: Four Tet
items.note: 把爵士、民谣与电子采样织成一张会呼吸的有机挂毯，现场感独一无二。
items.noteEn: Jazz, folk and electronic samples woven into a breathing, organic tapestry — a one-of-a-kind texture.

items.title: 扬声器与爱之深
items.creator: OutKast
items.note: 两张个人唱片合成一张双碟，〈Hey Ya!〉让它拿到 2004 年格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: Two solo records in one double album — "Hey Ya!" carried it to the 2004 Grammy Album of the Year.

items.title: 叶惠美
items.creator: 周杰伦
items.note: 《东风破》《晴天》——周杰伦「中国风」开山金曲专辑，金曲奖最佳专辑。
items.noteEn: With 'East Wind Breaks' and 'Sunny Day', the album that birthed Jay's Chinese-style hits and won the Golden Melody Best Album.

items.title: 教育
items.creator: 东京事变
items.note: 东京事变首张，把摇滚与爵士学院化，椎名林檎的集体变奏。
items.noteEn: Tokyo Jihen's debut academizing rock and jazz — Ringo's collective reinvention.

items.title: 疯狂恶棍
items.creator: Madvillain (MF DOOM & Madlib)
items.note: 两位地下怪杰的合体，把采样拼贴与意识流押韵做成抽象说唱的圣杯。
items.noteEn: Two underground eccentrics colliding — sample collage and stream-of-consciousness rhyme as abstract rap's grail.

items.title: 辍学
items.creator: Kanye West
items.note: 把灵魂乐采样切成高级时装般的节拍，Kanye 把说唱带进学院与教堂之间。
items.noteEn: Soul samples cut like couture — Kanye placed rap between the academy and the church.

items.title: 一个早晨
items.creator: Ludovico Einaudi
items.note: 极简钢琴与弦乐的小品集，同名曲因《无法触碰》电影成为大众入口。
items.noteEn: Minimal piano miniatures; the title piece reached millions via the film The Intouchables.

items.title: 迟到注册
items.creator: Kanye West
items.note: 与 Jon Brion 联手引入弦乐编排，〈Gold Digger〉把他推向全球舞台。
items.noteEn: Jon Brion's string arrangements and "Gold Digger" — Kanye's orchestral pop-rap breakthrough.

items.title: Soul Boy
items.creator: 方大同
items.note: 香港罕见的灵魂乐全创作，方大同以律动重塑华语男声。
items.noteEn: Hong Kong's rare all-original soul album; Khalil Fong rebuilt the Mandarin male voice on groove.

items.title: 回到黑色
items.creator: Amy Winehouse
items.note: 六十年代女子组合式的复古灵魂，2008 年格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: '60s girl-group soul rebuilt in the modern day — Grammy Album of the Year 2008.

items.title: 这一切没有想象的那么糟
items.en: It's Not as Bad as You Think
items.creator: 万晓利
items.note: 《狐狸》《陀螺》——万晓利把民谣玩成机智的黑色寓言。
items.noteEn: With 'The Fox' and 'Spinning Top', Wan Xiaoli turns folk into wry dark fables.

items.title: 衰败的精致化
items.en: And Their Refinement of the Decline
items.creator: Stars of the Lid
items.note: 弦乐与管风琴的慢速长音，把睡眠与聆听的边界磨得几乎消失。
items.noteEn: Slow strings and organ drones blur the line between listening and sleep.

items.title: 中国孩子
items.creator: 周云蓬
items.note: 盲诗人用歌声给底层写传，诗意与愤怒并存的民谣良心。
items.noteEn: A blind poet singing for the dispossessed — folk's conscience where poetry meets anger.

items.title: 彩虹里
items.creator: Radiohead
items.note: 「随你付」定价开启数字发行的新范式，音乐本身却是他们最温暖的一张。
items.noteEn: A pay-what-you-want release that rewrote digital economics — and the band's warmest record.

items.title: 不真实
items.creator: Burial
items.note: 把车库人声采样、雨声与地下铁音效做成一张失恋后的南伦敦夜地图。
items.noteEn: Sampled garage vocals, rain and tube-station ambience — a night map of south London after heartbreak.

items.title: Game
items.creator: Perfume
items.note: 电音女团 Perfume 的主流突破，极简 Techno 与偶像文化的结合。
items.noteEn: Perfume's mainstream breakthrough, marrying minimal techno with idol culture.

items.title: 贫民窟的百万富翁
items.creator: A.R. Rahman
items.note: 《Jai Ho》的节庆能量让印度声音登顶奥斯卡。
items.noteEn: 'Jai Ho''s festive energy carried Indian sound to an Oscar.

items.title: 名声
items.creator: Lady Gaga
items.note: 〈Poker Face〉与〈Just Dance〉把舞池流行和艺术人格一起推向主流。
items.noteEn: "Poker Face" and "Just Dance" took dance-pop and an art-school persona straight to the mainstream.

items.title: 我美丽黑暗扭曲的幻想
items.creator: Kanye West
items.note: 众星云集的巴洛克说唱史诗，把自负与脆弱同时放大到专辑规模。
items.noteEn: A baroque, all-star rap epic that amplifies ego and fragility to album scale.

items.title: 万能青年旅店
items.creator: 万能青年旅店
items.note: 《杀死那个石家庄人》——华北小城抑郁与爵士摇滚十年一遇的杰作。
items.noteEn: With 'Kill That Shijiazhuang Person', a once-a-decade jazz-rock portrait of northern-town ennui.

items.title: 郊区
items.creator: Arcade Fire
items.note: 把郊区的怀旧与焦虑写成乐队摇滚的宏大叙事，2011 年同时拿下水星奖与格莱美。
items.noteEn: Nostalgia and anxiety about suburbia as grand indie rock — Mercury Prize and Grammy winner in 2011.

items.creator: Adele
items.note: 分手专辑卖出三千万张，〈Rolling in the Deep〉把灵魂乐推向全球广播。
items.noteEn: A breakup album that sold 30 million — "Rolling in the Deep" carried soul onto global radio.

items.title: 第二人生
items.creator: 五月天
items.note: 末日与重生双概念，2012 金曲奖最佳国语专辑的摇滚大碟。
items.noteEn: A dual concept of apocalypse and rebirth; the rock album that took the 2012 Golden Melody Best Album.

items.title: The Boys
items.creator: 少女时代
items.note: 少女时代进军美国之作，K-Pop 女团工业化的巅峰展示。
items.noteEn: Girls' Generation's U.S.-bound statement, a peak display of the industrialized K-pop girl group.

items.title: 黑电台
items.creator: Robert Glasper Experiment
items.note: 爵士三重奏请来嘻哈与R&B歌手，2013年获格莱美最佳R&B专辑。
items.noteEn: A jazz trio fronted by R&B and hip-hop guests — the 2013 Grammy for Best R&B Album.

items.title: 橙色频道
items.creator: Frank Ocean
items.note: 把自传式的诚实放进 R&B 的柔光里，〈Thinkin Bout You〉让酷儿叙事进入主流。
items.noteEn: Autobiographical honesty in R&B's soft focus — "Thinkin Bout You" brought queer narratives mainstream.

items.title: 好孩子，疯狂的城
items.creator: Kendrick Lamar
items.note: 概念化的康普顿成长日记，把街头叙事拍成一部可以反复重看的电影。
items.noteEn: A conceptual Compton coming-of-age diary, shot like a film you can rewatch endlessly.

items.title: 白银饭店
items.creator: 张玮玮和郭龙
items.note: 西北民谣的手风琴挽歌，《米店》的情歌至今仍在回响。
items.noteEn: Accordion elegies of northwest folk; the love-song 'Rice Shop' still echoes.

items.title: 随机存取记忆
items.creator: Daft Punk
items.note: 请来真人乐手重新演奏迪斯科，〈Get Lucky〉让 Daft Punk 拿下格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: Live musicians re-playing disco — "Get Lucky" carried Daft Punk to a Grammy Album of the Year.

items.title: XOXO
items.creator: EXO
items.note: 时隔 12 年韩国首张百万销量专辑，《咆哮》确立新世代男团秩序。
items.noteEn: Korea's first million-selling album in 12 years; 'Growl' crowned the new boy-group order.

items.creator: Taylor Swift
items.note: 从乡村转向全合成器流行，〈Shake It Off〉让她成为奖项收割机。
items.noteEn: A full synth-pop pivot from country — "Shake It Off" turned her into an awards machine.

items.title: PLAY
items.creator: 乐童音乐家
items.note: 兄妹俩的清新民谣奇想，《200%》里都是元音的游戏。
items.noteEn: Siblings' winsome folk-pop fantasy, with the vowel-play of '200%'.

items.creator: Adele
items.note: 〈Hello〉一出手就打破首周销量纪录，用最朴素的写法收割最广的听众。
items.noteEn: "Hello" smashed first-week sales records — the plainest songwriting reaching the widest audience.

items.title: 睡眠
items.creator: Max Richter
items.note: 八小时、31段的「摇篮曲」，按睡眠节律设计，是夜晚真正的配乐。
items.noteEn: An eight-hour, 31-movement lullaby built to sleep through — music for the night.

items.title: 史诗
items.creator: Kamasi Washington
items.note: 三小时、17人的大编制，把科川式精神爵士带回2010年代的主流视野。
items.noteEn: Three hours, seventeen players — Coltrane-scale spiritual jazz restored to the mainstream.

items.title: 给蝴蝶拉皮条
items.creator: Kendrick Lamar
items.note: 放克、爵士与自由爵士的现场乐队质感，把黑人性、阶级与自我怀疑写成一部长诗。
items.noteEn: Live funk, jazz and free-jazz textures turning Blackness, class and self-doubt into a long-form poem.

items.title: 反了
items.creator: Rihanna
items.note: 比流行更松、比 R&B 更怪，〈Work〉之外塞满险象环生的冒险。
items.noteEn: Looser than pop, stranger than R&B — beyond "Work," a record full of adventurous detours.

items.title: 金发
items.creator: Frank Ocean
items.note: 极简的编曲与人声采样，把私人记忆做成一张可以被反复解读的概念专辑。
items.noteEn: Minimal arrangements and vocal samples turning private memory into endlessly interpretable concept art.

items.title: 爱乐之城
items.creator: Justin Hurwitz
items.note: 《City of Stars》重拾歌舞片配乐的爵士灵魂，奥斯卡最佳配乐。
items.noteEn: 'City of Stars' revived the jazz soul of movie musicals; Academy Award-winning score.

items.title: 柠檬水
items.creator: Beyoncé
items.note: 一张视觉专辑，把背叛、黑人与女性经验拍成六十分钟的檄文。
items.noteEn: A visual album — sixty minutes on betrayal, Blackness and womanhood, delivered as a manifesto.

items.title: MADE
items.creator: BIGBANG
items.note: 《Bang Bang Bang》与《Loser》——BIGBANG 对 K-Pop EDM 时代的声音总结。
items.noteEn: With 'Bang Bang Bang' and 'Loser', BIGBANG's assembled masterwork of K-pop's EDM era.

items.title: 异步
items.creator: Ryuichi Sakamoto
items.note: 坂本龙一癌症康复后的声响日记，钢琴与故障噪音并置出生命感。
items.noteEn: Sakamoto's sonic diary after cancer — piano and glitch set side by side, vividly alive.

items.title: BOOTLEG
items.creator: 米津玄师
items.note: 《打上花火》与《Loser》——米津玄师从 Vocaloid 到国民创作人的登基。
items.noteEn: With 'Uchiage Hanabi' and 'Loser', Yonezu ascended from Vocaloid to national songwriter.

items.title: 该死
items.creator: Kendrick Lamar
items.note: 更紧凑也更流行的转向，2018 年成为首个获得普利策音乐奖的说唱专辑。
items.noteEn: A tighter, more pop-facing turn — the first rap album to win the Pulitzer Prize for Music.

items.title: 纯真挽歌
items.creator: Lorde
items.note: 把青春期的心碎与派对做成概念化的室内乐流行，水星奖遗珠。
items.noteEn: Teenage heartbreak and house parties as a chamber-pop concept record — a Mercury shortlist gem.

items.title: Palette
items.creator: IU
items.note: IU 从国民妹妹到创作歌手的成年礼，慵懒而自洽。
items.noteEn: IU's coming-of-age from nation's little sister to singer-songwriter — languid and self-possessed.

items.title: Love Yourself 转 Tear
items.creator: BTS 防弹少年团
items.note: 首张登顶 Billboard 200 的 K-Pop 专辑，《Fake Love》席卷全球。
items.noteEn: The first K-pop album to top the Billboard 200, with 'Fake Love' sweeping the globe.

items.title: 当我们睡着时，我们去往何处
items.en: When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go?
items.creator: Billie Eilish
items.note: 卧室录音的耳语美学横扫格莱美四大通类，成为 Z 世代的时代音。
items.noteEn: Bedroom-recorded whisper-pop swept the four general Grammy categories — the sound of a generation.

items.title: 民俗志
items.creator: Taylor Swift
items.note: 隔离期的民谣转向，与 The National 的合作让她的写作沉到室内乐般的密度。
items.noteEn: A lockdown indie-folk turn with The National, sinking her songwriting to chamber-music density.

items.title: 未来乡愁
items.creator: Dua Lipa
items.note: 把迪斯科回潮做成疫情时代的逃生舱，〈Levitating〉是全世界的舞池。
items.noteEn: Disco revival as pandemic escape pod — "Levitating" became the world's dance floor.

items.title: THE ALBUM
items.creator: BLACKPINK
items.note: BLACKPINK 首张正规专辑，Girl Crush 美学的全球总攻。
items.noteEn: BLACKPINK's debut LP — the global assault of the 'girl crush' aesthetic.

items.title: 酸
items.creator: Olivia Rodrigo
items.note: 把少女的心碎写得句句扎心，〈drivers license〉创下流媒体时代的纪录。
items.noteEn: Teen heartbreak written with brutal precision — "drivers license" set streaming-era records.

items.title: 哈里的房子
items.creator: Harry Styles
items.note: 以七十年代软摇滚为底的流行私房照，2023 年拿下格莱美年度专辑。
items.noteEn: A '70s-soft-rock-tinged pop house tour that won Album of the Year at the 2023 Grammys.
